schedule_policy: Every-edge ABI; no FIFO, ready, retry, lease, or constant-folding assumption. Upstream producer must establish any additional static property.

local_geometry.adoption_requires: actual SRAM packing, faces, local streets, all per-bit hops, clock/reset taps and die capacity
